reason: Both correctly identify the flame failure device/thermocouple and escalate to a Gas Safe engineer, but Conversation 1 is a single terse turn that asks none of the important unknowns (knob hold time, flame shape near the probe, gas smell at rest) and dismisses the legitimate possibility of burner contamination. Conversation 2 explains the FFD, elicits exactly those facts, stays within the safety boundary (only cool-and-off external cleaning, no disassembly, stop repeated lighting attempts, meter/0800 111 999 and CO guidance), and gives practical escalation advice including capturing the data badge so the engineer can fit the right thermocouple. Conversation 2's wire-wool/cocktail-stick cleaning suggestions and the initially wrong rating-plate location are minor flaws that do not outweigh its far more thorough and honest handling.
